name: VStack
description: VStack is a vertical layout primitive built on Stack. It arranges elements in a column with configurable alignment and spacing, providing a simple way to stack items top-to-bottom without managing full flexbox props.

props.name: as
props.description: Polymorphic prop to change the rendered element type

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of items along the cross axis, supports responsive values

props.name: gap
props.description: Shorthand spacing between items, supports responsive values
